parts.text: Use read_file to read notes.txt. Report its exact marker and port, then stop. Do not modify files.
Print every integer from 1 through 4000, one integer per line. Do not use tools. Begin immediately.
Answer helpfully and concisely. Retain the conversation's details.

functionDeclarations.description: Replace exactly one non-overlapping exact anchor. Refuse zero or multiple matches; read the file and choose a unique anchor.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.
